مُغْتَلِمٌ : see its fem. voce غَلِمٌ. ―
-b2- سِقَآءٌ مُغْتَلِمٌ, (Mgh, TA,) and خَابِيَةٌ مُغْتَلِمَةٌ, (TA,) (tropical:) [A skin, and a jar,] of which the beverage, or wine, is strong in its influence upon the head. (Mgh, TA. *) ―
-b3- The خَارِجِىّ is called مَارِقٌ مُغْتَلِمٌ (assumed tropical:) [A deviater from the true religion,] an exceeder of the prescribed limit. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
